notes: CONTRACT BREAK — CONFIRMED BY GREP: 0 of the 34 keys on this leaf reach the app. Not one. Verified two ways: (1) assets/l10n/en.yaml has no `meditation.reminder` node at all — the only children of `meditation:` are intent, duration, mood, player, footsoak, vibes_check, subtle_system; (2) all 34 strings exist verbatim under `meditation.intent`, each with a literal `reminder_` prefix on the key name (en.yaml lines 204-237, e.g. `reminder_prompt_title`, `reminder_sheet_title`, `reminder_preset_unwind_later_today`, `reminder_notification_title`, `reminder_allow_notifications_screen_title`). The app reads them as `context.el.meditation.intent.reminderPromptTitle` etc.

WHY NOTHING GETS THROUGH: the CMS-to-app overlay in lib/preview/translation_preview.dart applies a CMS leaf onto an app path by EXACT key name (`_deepOverlay` — a CMS key with no identically-named counterpart in the app tree is silently skipped). The mapping table in that file has an entry for appPath ['meditation','intent'] -> cmsPath ['meditation','intent'] and NO entry at all for cmsPath ['meditation','reminder']. So even if a mapping were added, every key would still be dropped, because `prompt_title` != `reminder_prompt_title`. Both halves are broken: the leaf is unmapped AND the key names differ.

WHAT A FIX NEEDS: a `keyPrefix` concept on the leaf mapping, not a per-key remap table. One mapping entry — cmsPath ['meditation','reminder'] -> appPath ['meditation','intent'] with keyPrefix 'reminder_' — makes `_deepOverlay` write `reminder_` + each CMS key into the meditation.intent map, and all 34 land at once. A 34-row remap would work too but is pure duplication and will rot as keys are added. Do NOT fix this by renaming CMS slugs to `reminder_*`: slugs are data, stored translations and the English seed are keyed on them, and a rename orphans every existing translation.

SECOND-ORDER RISK once the prefix fix lands: the CMS also has a separate `meditation.intent` leaf that already maps 1:1 onto the same app section. Both leaves would then write into meditation.intent. That is fine only as long as no `reminder_`-prefixed CMS key exists on the intent leaf. Worth a one-line guard or a check at implementation time. Note that `set_reminder_for_later` (en.yaml line 203) legitimately belongs to the intent leaf, not here — it is the entry-point link into this flow, not part of it.

TRANSLATOR TIME: because zero keys are live, this whole tab is currently a decoy. Recommend hiding it or leaving the warning prominent until the keyPrefix fix ships — otherwise translators will do 34 keys of work that renders nowhere.

No {token} placeholders in any of these 34 strings. Several do contain deliberate line breaks (\n) — prompt_title, prompt_subtitle, sheet_title, allow_notifications_screen_subtitle — which translators should preserve so the text wraps as designed.

Order note: `prompt_set_reminder` and `sheet_dont_set` each appear at two points in the flow (the offer panel and the time picker; the day list and the time picker). Each is listed once, at its first appearance, and its description says where else it shows.

Order note: `sheet_done`, `sheet_return_to_meditation` and `sheet_leave_meditation` are not extra buttons — they are alternative labels that replace `sheet_explore_app` / `sheet_start_first_meditation` on the same confirmation screen, depending on where the reminder was set from. Grouped with them for that reason.

The strings exist only in assets/l10n/en.yaml (top-level `path_meditation_feedback:`, lines 516-524) and in the generated localization/lib/localization.dart; nothing reads them.

What was good and what could be improved?' = description), line 102 ('Please write at least 50 characters' = error_length), line 120 ('Type here..' = hint), line 151 ('Send' = send). The thank-you half is in widgets/meditation_feedback_thank_you.dart: line 44 ('Thank you!' = thank_you), 'Your feedback\nhelps us improve\nthis app' (= thank_you_description) and 'Close' (= close).

KEPT, NOT DELETED, per instruction: the fix is a one-line-per-string app change (swap the literals for the l10n accessors), which is a product/engineering decision, not a translation decision. If that change ships, the whole 'Currently unused' section should be re-sectioned into the normal screen order: title, description, error_length, hint, send | thank_you, thank_you_description, close — which is the order they are already listed in.

Note the naming mismatch worth checking during that fix: the CMS leaf is meditation.feedback / meditation_feedback, but the English seed lives under the top-level `path_meditation_feedback:` node in en.yaml, not under `meditation:`. notes: CONTRACT BREAK CONFIRMED BY GREP. The CMS leaf is 'profile.privacy'; the app's matching screen keeps its text under 'profile.privacy_advertising' in assets/l10n/en.yaml, and its keys were renamed to the ads_* / product_* family. Overrides are applied by exact key name within a mapped leaf, so a renamed key silently does nothing.
Exactly 1 of the 19 keys still matches a key the app looks for: status_allowed. Everything else is renamed, split, merged, or removed.

Name-by-name mapping to the app's current keys: screen_title→title, status_not_allowed→status_off, advertising_title→ads_title, advertising_body_benefits→ads_body_why, advertising_body_change_hint→ads_body_change_anytime, product_analytics_title→product_title, product_analytics_description→product_body, learn_more_header→learn_more. advertising_body_intro was split into ads_body_intro_before_link + what_we_share + ads_body_intro_after_link, and advertising_body_never_share into ads_body_never_share_lead + ads_body_never_share_middle + ads_body_never_sell_lead + ads_body_never_sell_tail — so the two richText keys cannot be mapped one-to-one and need a schema change, not just a rename.

advertising_platforms_header and the three advertising_platform_* keys have no app counterpart at all: the app no longer lists the platforms separately, it names Meta, Apple Search Ads and Google Ads inside the intro sentence. Removing them is a product decision, so they are kept.

The four legal-link keys (privacy_policy_title/subtitle, terms_and_conditions_title/subtitle) are duplicates: the screen renders those two rows from profile.main, not from this leaf. Either point the screen at this leaf or drop these four — a product/engineering decision.

The app screen also has strings with no home in this leaf at all: status_loading, status_allowed_on and status_off_since (these last two contain a {date} placeholder that must be kept), what_we_share, read_more_here, the whole 'are you sure you want to turn this off' confirmation screen (ads_off_confirm_question, ads_off_confirm_body_before_link, ads_off_confirm_body_after_link, keep_on, turn_off), and three error messages (load_error, ads_update_error, product_update_error). None of these can be translated today.

There is also no preview mapping for this leaf, so this tab cannot currently be previewed in the CMS the way profile.account can. Recommend hiding or clearly banner-warning this tab for translators until the schema is realigned with profile.privacy_advertising.
